relations.text: 2025年から5年間、採掘用の硝酸アンモニウム溶液を最大年15万トン供給する契約
relations.text_en: Five-year deal from 2025 to supply up to 150,000 tons a year of ammonium nitrate solution

source.label: LSB Industries 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In May 2024, we announced an agreement to supply, for a five-year period commencing January 1, 2025, up to 150,000 short tons per year of low carbon ammonium nitrate solution ("ANS") to Freeport Minerals Corporation ("Freeport").

relations.text: インドネシアの製錬所PT Smeltingの合弁相手で、2024年に売上の10%以上を占めた唯一の顧客
relations.text_en: PT Smelting joint venture partner and the only customer above 10% of revenue (in 2024)

source.label: Freeport-McMoRan 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: For the three years ended December 31, 2025, the only customer that accounted for 10% or more of our consolidated revenues was Mitsubishi Materials Corporation, PTFI's joint venture partner in PT Smelting (PTFI's 66%-owned copper smelter and refinery), in 2024.

relations.text: 米モレンシー銅山の28%を保有する共同保有者

source.label: Freeport-McMoRan 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We own a 72% undivided interest in Morenci, with the remaining 28% owned by Sumitomo Metal Mining Arizona, Inc.

relations.text: ペルーのセロベルデ銅山の21%も保有
relations.text_en: Also holds 21% of Cerro Verde in Peru

source.label: Freeport-McMoRan 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Cerro Verde We have a 55.08% ownership interest in Cerro Verde, with the remaining 44.92% ownership interest held by SMM Cerro Verde Netherlands B.V. (21.0%), Compañia de Minas Buenaventura S.A.A. (19.58%) and other stockholders

relations.text_en: Shareholders' agreement for the Aurora Minerals exploration venture in Canada (August 2025)

source.label: Amarc Resources 20-F(2026年4月期)
source.quote: On August 20, 2025, Amarc signed a shareholder's agreement with Freeport-McMoRan Mineral Properties Canada Inc.

relations.text: BHPが20-Fで、銅の競合の一社としてFreeportを挙げる
relations.text_en: BHP names Freeport among its copper competitors

source.label: BHP 20-F(2026年6月期)
source.quote: Competitors include: Anglo American, Antofagasta, Codelco, Freeport, Glencore, Rio Tinto, Southern Copper, Teck.

relations.text: Valeが20-Fで、銅精鉱市場の最大の競合の一社としてFreeportを挙げる

source.label: Vale 20-F(2025年度)
source.quote: The largest competitors in the copper concentrate market are BHP Group, Rio Tinto, Codelco, Glencore, Zijin Mining, Anglo American, and Freeport McMoRan
